# opstracer_service (Data Source)

Look up a service by its exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_service" "checkout" {
  name = "checkout-api"
}

output "checkout_policy_id" {
  value = data.opstracer_service.checkout.escalation_policy_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name, matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `escalation_policy_id` (String) ID of the escalation policy that pages for this service.
- `id` (String) Service ID.
